study.question: Does task-specific event-local feedback/target-match modulation improve retrieval beyond the incumbent additive evidence readout, and does feedback identity matter within this routing path?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g3-r0008-feedback_match_evidence achieved click AUC 0.6618104871 versus 0.6602926533 for g3-r0008-feedback_availability_control (target-equality effect +0.0015178338). With collapsed feedback the corresponding effect is +0.0014779419 (0.6617253391 versus 0.6602473972). Resolving feedback adds only +0.0000851481 click AUC with matches, although auxiliary AUCs rise from [0.8510924,0.8673845,0.8720115] to [0.8526085,0.8688931,0.8753037]. The click interaction is only +0.0000398919; feedback-specific click benefit is provisional. Code inspection shows these statistics currently enter only a linear additive logit branch, without explicitly selecting which event values reach a task tower. Mechanism hypothesis: target-matched feedback should condition each task's event pooling, allowing semantic retrieval without restoring harmful auxiliary gradients into primary item embeddings. A bounded, task-specific event gain may improve useful event selection. Uniform history scaling and collapsed-feedback controls discriminate alternative explanations; no gain is assumed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text arXiv:1706.06978v4 lines250-277 inspected: target-conditioned local activation and unnormalized weighted sums are inherited. New gate multiplies existing task scores using deterministic host-feedback x valid target-match indicators; target-conditioned attention itself is prior work. No general architectural priority claim.

Pinned benchmark code commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d lines123-169 and188-224 inspected. Task-feedback masks initialize projected sequence hubs, then categorical/sequence/task hubs repeatedly aggregate and broadcast. We instead retain private item paths and one-shot DIN pooling, adding only event-local bounded task gains and a uniform-gain replacement. No hubs, iterative broadcasts or INFNet reproduction are implemented. paper:infnet detailed original text is unavailable through the authorized registry; benchmark fallback does not verify original-method equivalence or novelty.

Only pinned author README is available, including its missing category/brand field warning; publisher primary text remains unavailable. This does not verify a mechanism difference from full DMR. Novelty relative to DMR and the wider multi-behavior literature remains unverified.

Trajectory review: task feedback retrieval alone in g3-r0000-task_feedback_retrieval (0.6554608) did not beat its item-only control (0.6558818); primary selector ownership in g3-r0001-primary_feedback (0.6576086) improved over joint_feedback (0.6554608). Added auxiliary selectors in g3-r0002-aux_live (0.6567847) underperformed wide_primary (0.6583679). Blocking auxiliary item gradients in g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary raised click AUC to0.6601634 but collapsed auxiliary AUCs to[0.67982,0.72358,0.66262]; private tables in g3-r0005-private_aux_items restored auxiliaries while keeping click0.6601638, at more parameters and ~484s rather than~367s. Fixed private tables slightly improved click to0.6604036 but did not dominate all task quality. Partial gradients/loss scaling in round4 did not recover a better joint tradeoff. Learned auxiliary residual transfer in g3-r0006-learned_aux_transfer reduced click to0.6592575; self/fixed controls did not establish a transfer benefit. Re-sharing label fields in g3-r0007-label_fields_shared reduced click to0.6592437; other/all-field sharing also lost click versus private0.6601638. These are negative implementations, not refutations of all task-conditioned interaction. All indexed trials succeeded in execution and previous_runtime_error is null; there is no new failed execution to repair.
study.proposed_difference: Add W with shape[4,20], 80 zero-initialized dense weights after the inherited reset. For each valid event form phi=outer([exposure, four historical feedback masks], [valid exposure, same nonmissing category, same nonmissing brand, joint match]), flattened channel-major. Compute h_t=tanh(W_t phi) in FP32 and gain=1+h_t in [0,2] in floating-point (tanh may saturate); multiply the inherited task pooling score by the gain before both primary/private value pooling, then restore its dtype for inherited BF16 bmm. All original logits still receive the same resolved additive evidence correction. Mean replacements apply 1+mean_valid(h_t) uniformly, computing both h and its mean in all variants. Feedback-collapse replacements average the four feedback entries only for phi, preserving exposure and feedback multiplicity, and retain four repeated slots and the same allocated W. Missing/padded IDs do not count as equal and feedback masks are intersected with valid history. Gate parameters receive only their own task loss; no learned auxiliary donor or current label enters the gate.
predictions: Before any optimization, all four zero-gate variants should reproduce parent predictions under copied inherited parameters; event/mean gains equal1, including empty histories. For a one-event history the event and mean replacements are functionally identical at equal parameters. Violations are implementation failures, not scientific counterevidence.

Primary screening prediction: event_feedback_gate exceeds mean_feedback_gate in full validation click AUC by at least0.0002 while exceeding the archived parent. This is a practical provisional criterion; all signed differences and Logloss must be reported even below it. event_collapsed_gate versus mean_collapsed_gate tests the same event-selection effect without gate-local feedback identity.

A specific feedback-type routing claim additionally predicts event_feedback_gate exceeds event_collapsed_gate and the factorial interaction (event_resolved-mean_resolved)-(event_collapsed-mean_collapsed) is positive; report that interaction without treating one seed as significance. If only auxiliary tasks improve, report a task tradeoff rather than a primary improvement.

Predeclared host-reported history bins remain0,1..16,17..64,>64 with counts/positives/negatives. Retrieval-specific gains should occur for nonempty multi-event histories; empty-history predictions after training may still differ through global parameter trajectories, so empty-slice AUC differences alone do not prove leakage. Feedback/target-match composition diagnostics require authorized host inputs and must not be invented when unavailable.

Allocated parameters should equal56,349,784 for all four variants; estimate only ~small arithmetic overhead relative to the parent, but actual GPU seconds, wall time, memory and batch latency determine efficiency. Matched data-pass results isolate this replacement; no equal-compute superiority claim follows from them.
falsifiers: If event-specific variants fail to beat corresponding mean-gain replacements across paired repetitions, useful event-location selection is not supported for this implementation. A gain shared with uniform scaling supports rescaling/optimization as an alternative.
If gate-local identity collapse matches or beats resolved routing, feedback-specific gate benefit is unsupported, even if matched-feedback counts remain useful in the inherited additive branch.

If only candidate-versus-parent improves but matched replacements do equally well, the event-routing explanation is unestablished. If all gates lose, retain the archived incumbent; bounded-gate learning under one-pass/BF16 may be a failed implementation rather than a universal mechanism refutation.

Any use of current targets' actions, labels in forward, invalid history, missing-ID equality, modified host recipe or auxiliary leakage into primary-owned item/selector parameters invalidates the run. Do not score an invalid candidate.

If measured quality gains disappear under paired seeds or require materially worse measured resource use, retract the corresponding repeated-support or efficiency interpretation; keep original receipts and superseding explanations.
alternative_explanations: One fixed seed and one epoch can produce optimization-specific differences. Treat 0.0002 AUC as a practical screening threshold, not a significance level; repeat selected comparisons before mechanism conclusions.

Mean gains match the unweighted valid-event mean at identical gate parameters; separately trained solutions need not have the same gains, score-weighted mean or gradient geometry. The control isolates event-location dependence from one plausible uniform rescaling replacement, not every capacity explanation.

Collapsed gate features preserve exposure and mean feedback multiplicity but have lower effective rank. Action embeddings, inherited selector and additive evidence still retain feedback identity; this is a gate-local ablation, not global removal of feedback information.

Target matches may mostly encode category/brand recurrence or user history intensity. Additive count gains do not by themselves establish complementary task semantics.

The multiplicative gain cannot reverse the sign of unnormalized DIN scores, so high gain is not necessarily positive attention. Saturation or small BF16-resolved updates may limit this particular bounded parameterization; host gradient/gain diagnostics can motivate a separate admissible follow-up.
